categories.representative_structure: A certificate-qualified validity label is followed by, or shares a line with, a parseable date.
categories.root_cause: Extractors accepted bare validity labels but not the semantically equivalent certificate-qualified label.
categories.implemented_fix: Added the full semantic label alias while retaining field-specific date normalization.

categories.representative_structure: Label and value are horizontally aligned, but small OCR box-height differences place the value immediately before the label in flattened order.
categories.root_cause: Sequential next-line lookup cannot recover a same-row value that sorts before its label.
categories.implemented_fix: Added a bounded nearest-right observation fallback only when the label line has no value and the field validator accepts the candidate.

categories.representative_structure: A standalone institution name is present, but the document provides no explicit university label.
categories.root_cause: Label-only extraction has no conservative fallback for a full-line institution-name pattern.
categories.implemented_fix: Added a transcript-specific full-line university-name candidate with strict semantic shape and direct evidence.

categories.representative_structure: The required value is absent or unusable in OCR observations despite high page-average OCR confidence.
categories.root_cause: Downstream extraction has no trustworthy source candidate.
categories.implemented_fix: Left unresolved; OCR/preprocessing research remains deferred rather than inferring from unrelated values.
